conclusion: Approach-specific system identification improves replay; universal full-episode response fails. No grasp, transport or ACT success demonstrated.
limitations: Second fit scope was an adaptive follow-up after reviewing the first diagnostic; the same held-out episodes were reused. This is exploratory evidence, not a fresh confirmatory test.
Only training episodes determine coefficients, delays and candidate selection.
MuJoCo follows a precomputed predicted trajectory from recorded initial state; online ACT feedback through a response adapter has not been tested.
FK discrepancy is model-based, not measured physical tool error.
No contacts, payload or phase signal in this model; do not deploy across the whole task.
next: Test a separate frozen-ACT approach diagnostic with a causal online response adapter and an explicitly nonprivileged phase/horizon rule before considering production adoption.
